test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, what is one way to ensure technology benefits children?

options.text: Avoid any use of digital tools entirely.
Allow unlimited screen time to encourage freedom.
Monitor content and set clear time limits.
Encourage children to use screens late at night.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage provides specific recommendations to make technology a positive tool for development. In the final paragraph, it states: **"Encouraging offline activities, monitoring content, and setting time limits are some strategies recommended..."**
 
• Option 3</strong&
